text:
maria: Heads-up — discovered inconsistent env var names in devtools sample apps. Some use REDWOOD_API_KEY, others REDWOOD_KEY and the CLI expects REDWOOD_TOKEN. That's causing onboarding friction for new hires. Anyone know the intended precedence/fallback?

ashwin: oof. We never settled on a canonical name. Current runtime fallback is: CLI flag > ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_KEY > credentials file. But SDKs differ — python looks for REDWOOD_API_KEY only.

sam: That mismatch is bad. Suggest we adopt REDWOOD_API_KEY as canonical and add REDWOOD_PROJECT / REDWOOD_ORG for scoping instead of encoding project in API key. Also add a --org flag to the CLI.

jules: Agreed. Also important: rotation flows. For CI we should support short-lived tokens via the /sessions endpoint so rotation is transparent. Long-lived keys should be prefixed (e.g. rk_ for long-lived, rs_ for sessions).

maria: Could we standardize key prefixes? Our docs don't mention rk_/rs_.

ashwin: we added prefixes in the vault spec but didn't publish. Will open PR to docs and change SDK lookup to accept all three env names but emit a warning if a non-canonical var is used.

sam: Other note — retries: SDK should not retry 401s, and should surface a clear "AuthFailure" error that includes a "maybe rotated" hint. Also log a one-time telemetry event when a token fails due to rotation so we can detect widespread breaks.

jules: parity issue: JS SDK currently retries 401 once because the fetch wrapper groups 401/5xx. Need to special-case 401 and surface to app.

devops-bot: docs: https://redwood.example/docs/auth/env-conventions (automated link)

maria: I'll open a tiny RFC — change env canonical name to REDWOOD_API_KEY, publish prefix rules, and update 3 SDKs (js,py,go) to match fallback+warning policy. Can someone volunteer to triage SDK PRs? @ashwin?

ashwin: I'll take JS + docs. ping me on PR.

sam: I can handle Python + add session token helper in sampleapp (scripts/rotate-cred.sh).

jules: I'll do Go + add cred-lint rule to repo that flags non-canonical env names.

maria: Thanks! One more ask — can we add sampleapp script `scripts/rotate-cred.sh` that demos CI-friendly rotation? small shell, curl to /sessions and writes env. low effort.

sam: +1 will draft.

maria: perfect, thanks all :rocket:
